text: Election of the Vice Chair of the Board of Directors of TO Live under Part H, Section 23, of the Board of Directors of TO Live Procedures By-law 2-2021, for a term of office ending December 31, 2024, and until a successor is appointed.

The Board of Directors of TO Live: 1. Elected Councillor Gary Crawford as Vice Chair of the Board of Directors of TO Live for a term of office ending December 31, 2024, and until a successor is appointed.
